name: exp-quake: Quake software renderer with Unreal 1 dithering

mentions.name: exp-quake: Quake software renderer with Unreal 1 dithering
mentions.description: An experimental build of Quake's software renderer that applies the famous Unreal 1 dithering technique to its output, packaged with a clean Linux build. The dithering approach is based on Tim Sweeney's write-up of Unreal's texturing method.
mentions.source_excerpt: After that Deus Ex remaster fiasco, I wanted to see how the famous Unreal 1 dithering technique would look on Quake's software renderer. Getting a clean build of it on Linux was fun in itself: https://github.com/klaussilveira/exp-quake
